question: Votes with Trump?
headline: AUTO
rule: Counts every House roll call on final disposition of a measure (passage, agreeing to a resolution, concurring in a Senate amendment, or suspending the rules and passing it) for which the White House issued a statement of administration policy that states a clear position, plus two votes whose sources are noted. Trump's position is that statement's position: support means he wanted a Yea, opposition a Nay. Headline: 'Reliably with Trump' if the member cast the White House position on at least 95% of these votes and on every one where 10 or more Republicans voted the other way; 'Mostly with Trump' at 80% to 94%; 'Often against Trump' below 80%. The same rule applies to every Republican.
summary: Cast the White House position on {trumpWith} of {trumpN} votes with a documented Trump position; against it on {trumpAgainst}.
tiles: of {trumpN} votes with a documented Trump position cast with it

mandate.intro: Heritage Foundation's Mandate for Leadership (2023) is the Project 2025 policy book. Each row quotes a Mandate proposal with its page, then the bill or vote it matches. “Direct” means the Mandate names the bill or the same action; “same target” means the bill acts on the same subject in the Mandate's direction; “partial” says exactly where the bill differs. A match shows alignment of policy, not intent or coordination.

items.proposal: Enact the Midnight Rules Relief Act, so several late-term regulations can be disapproved together
items.quote: Congress and the President should enact the Midnight Rules Relief Act

source.label: Mandate for Leadership (Heritage Foundation, 2023)

items.match: The Mandate names this bill. H.R. 77 provides for en bloc consideration of resolutions disapproving “midnight rules.”

items.proposal: Prevent a central bank digital currency
items.quote: Prevent the institution of a central bank digital currency (CBDC).

source.label: Mandate for Leadership (Heritage Foundation, 2023)

items.match: H.R. 1919 prohibits the use of a central bank digital currency for monetary policy and bars Federal Reserve banks from offering certain products directly to individuals.

items.proposal: Limit California's Clean Air Act waiver
items.quote: Restore the position that California’s waiver applies only to California-specific issues like ground-level ozone, not global climate issues.

source.label: Mandate for Leadership (Heritage Foundation, 2023)

items.match: The Mandate calls for narrowing California's waiver. H.J.Res. 87 uses the Congressional Review Act to nullify EPA's waiver decision on Advanced Clean Trucks and related rules.
